g.text: The largest users of AI compute are not the largest owners of it

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: observed compute by the company that owns each site against the company recorded as its primary user. The

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: gap between the two is the rental market: labs run on capacity other companies built.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers (CC-BY) — data_centers.csv + data_center_timelines.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published data centers documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Observed data only, at the 2026-09-08 snapshot. Epoch records a user for 64 of 86 sites; where it does not, the site appears under

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: "Unknown" on the user side, which is why the Unknown user bar is large. Only the first listed user is taken as primary, so shared

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: sites are attributed whole to one tenant and the user side is coarser than the owner side. Both columns total the same 13.9M

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: H100-equivalents. Ownership and use are Epoch attributions carrying their own confidence tags, not contractual facts.
